Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

dream — something you really want to do. Example: My dream is to open a café.
goal — something you want to achieve. Example: My goal this year is to learn English.
hope — to want something to happen. Example: I hope to travel to Italy.
want — to wish to have or do something. Example: I want to learn Spanish.
learn — to get a new skill. Example: I want to learn English well.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• My dream is to ...
• I want to ...
• I hope to ...
• My goal is to ...
• It is my big dream.
